name: Crystal
overview: Scripture presents crystal as a symbol of purity, preciousness, and divine glory. In Job 28:17, crystal is compared to gold and jewels, highlighting its value beyond earthly riches. Ezekiel 1:22 and Revelation 4:6 depict crystal imagery associated with God's majestic presence, emphasizing its clarity and beauty. Furthermore, Revelation 21:11 and 22:1 describe crystal-like brilliance and purity in the New Jerusalem and the river of life, underscoring the holiness and perfection found in God's eternal kingdom.
